profile.headline: Lead Web Developer @ Chamoy Creative | Full-Stack Development
profile.summary:
With over 10 years of coding and web development experience, I am a lead developer at Chamoy Creative, a digital agency that provides custom technology solutions and creative services to clients across various industries. I have a background in engineering from UT Austin and a certification in full-stack development from Codeup, a leading coding bootcamp in Texas.

I specialize in WordPress, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, and I have developed web applications and websites for various projects, ranging from e-commerce platforms, online learning systems, and content management systems. I enjoy engineering custom technology solutions and creative problem solving, and I am always eager to learn and adapt to new challenges and technologies. I work effectively either on my own or as part of a team, and I value collaboration, innovation, and quality. I am passionate about creating impactful and user-friendly digital products that enhance the productivity and digital footprint of my clients.
